figures.name: Aiyy Toyon

ability.name: White Creator
ability.description: Bring pure light into the darkest field; remove all dark effects and grant +3 to all allies.

figures.description: The supreme benevolent creator deity of the Sakha people, lord of the upper world, who created humans and sent them the warmth of the sun.

figures.name: Ulu Toyon

ability.name: Dark Gift
ability.description: Grant a shaman card forbidden power; they gain +5 magic but become dark-aligned for 2 turns.

figures.description: The powerful deity of the middle and lower worlds, who gave shamanic powers to humans, ambiguous force that both aids and threatens.

figures.name: Iyeykhsit

ability.name: Birth Blessing
ability.description: Bring a new card into existence from the deck; it is born onto the field with full stats.

figures.description: The beneficent goddess who presides over the birth of children and cattle, essential to the pastoral and family life of the Sakha people.

figures.name: Aiyy Syra Toyon

ability.name: Summer Sun
ability.description: Extend summer for 2 turns; all life-aligned cards gain 3 HP per turn.

figures.description: The solar deity of the Sakha, whose warmth is especially cherished in the extreme cold of Siberia, bringing the brief but intense summer.

figures.name: Aan Darhan Toyon

ability.name: Eternal Hearth
ability.description: The hearth fire cannot be extinguished; all allied cards are protected from cold and winter effects.

figures.description: The fire lord and hearth deity, whose sacred fire was central to the survival of the Sakha through the brutal Siberian winters.

figures.name: Olonkho Hero

ability.name: Olonkho Battle
ability.description: Sing an epic battle chant; all allied cards gain +3 to all stats for 2 turns.

figures.description: The great hero of the Olonkho, the Sakha epic performance tradition inscribed by UNESCO, who battles the Abaasy underworld creatures.

figures.name: Abaasy

ability.name: Cold Plague
ability.description: Send illness from the underworld; all enemy cards lose 2 HP per turn for 3 turns.

figures.description: The underworld demons of Sakha belief who cause illness and misfortune, who must be battled by shamans to protect the living.

figures.name: Udagan (Female Shaman)

ability.name: White Shamaness Journey
ability.description: Travel to the upper world; retrieve one blessing and apply it to all allied cards.

figures.description: The female shaman of the Sakha people, who travels to the upper worlds and works with benevolent spirits to heal and protect.

figures.name: Oyun (Male Shaman)

ability.name: Lower World Battle
ability.description: Battle underworld spirits; defeat one Abaasy and gain their power as a stat boost.

figures.description: The male shaman of the Sakha, who battles underworld spirits and performs rituals at the great Ysyakh summer festival.

figures.name: White Horse

ability.name: Ysyakh Offering
ability.description: Perform the sacred offering; the sun deity grants all allies +2 to all stats.

figures.description: The white horse sacred to the sun deity, offered at the great Ysyakh summer festival, symbol of the link between the Sakha and their sky deities.

figures.name: Mammoth (Spirit)

ability.name: Ancient Trembling
ability.description: Stomp the earth; all grounded enemy cards are stunned for 1 turn.

figures.description: The spirit of the mammoth, whose bones and tusks emerge from the Siberian permafrost, believed by the Sakha to be underground beings that cause earthquakes.

figures.name: Burkit (Eagle)

ability.name: Eagle Vision
ability.description: See all hidden cards and abilities on the field; share the vision with all allied cards.

figures.description: The eagle as a sacred shaman helper spirit of the Sakha, who assists the shaman in flying to the upper worlds and provides clarity of vision.

figures.name: Kynta Toyon

ability.name: Siberian Winter
ability.description: Plunge the field into winter; all speed stats are halved and cold-domain cards gain immunity.

figures.description: The lord of winter and cold, whose season defines life and death for the Sakha people, testing their endurance each year.

figures.name: Ebe Khotiun

ability.name: Earth Old Woman
ability.description: Nurture the earth; all nature-domain allied cards gain 4 HP and +2 defense.

figures.description: The earth old woman, mother earth deity of the Sakha, who nurtures vegetation and is propitiated before the spring planting.

figures.name: Kunnei

ability.name: Sun Maiden's Grace
ability.description: Shower allies with sunlight; all allied cards gain +2 magic and are healed for 3 HP.

figures.description: The sun maiden spirit of Sakha tradition, associated with the beautiful brief summer and the grace of sunlight on the frozen land.

figures.name: Syulyukun

ability.name: River Pull
ability.description: Pull one enemy into the river depths; they lose all speed and aquatic movement advantages.

figures.description: The water spirits of Sakha rivers who can either help or harm fishermen, propitiated before fishing and river crossings.

figures.name: Elley Bootur

ability.name: Great Migration
ability.description: Lead all allied cards to a new position; choose optimal placement for all.

figures.description: The legendary ancestor hero who led the Sakha people to their homeland around Lake Baikal and down to the Lena River basin.

figures.name: Zhir Biir Toyon

ability.name: Middle World Balance
ability.description: Restore balance to the field; equalize all extreme stat differences among all cards.

figures.description: The lord of the middle world in Sakha cosmology, who maintains the order of the realm between the heavens and the underworld.

figures.name: Orion (Sakha constellation)

ability.name: Star Hunter
ability.description: Navigate by stars; predict and avoid the next 2 enemy attacks perfectly.

figures.description: The Orion constellation as understood by the Sakha hunters, whose stars guide winter hunting expeditions across the frozen landscape.

figures.name: Juruyung Aiyy Toyon

ability.name: White Blessing
ability.description: Grant the ultimate white blessing; all allied cards are fully healed and gain +2 to all stats.

figures.description: Another aspect of the supreme white creator deity, specifically associated with white horses and the benevolent upper world in Sakha cosmology.
